stemMarkdown: Walking at 4 km/h a student reaches school 20 minutes late, and walking at 6 km/h he reaches 5 minutes early. Find the distance (in km) to the school. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The two journeys differ in time by $20 + 5 = 25$ minutes $= 0.4167$ hours. If the distance is $d$, then $\dfrac{d}{4} - \dfrac{d}{6} = 0.4167$, giving $d = 5.0$ km.
